name: MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL (Xiaomi FP8)
summary: Xiaomi's large MoE with a 512k context. The recommended start for two Sparks.
notes: Verified on 2 × DGX Spark 2026-10-05: correct answers in English and Swedish, tool calls work, ~25 tok/s for one stream, 791k tokens of KV cache at 512k context (1.51x; 776k and 2.96x at 256k). The model supports 1M, but the KV cache does not fit a full 1M request. Xiaomi's MoE, 309B total / 15B active. Runs on vLLM's official MiMo image (vLLM 0.29.1), which has no Ray, so the nodes join with vLLM's own multi-node mode; the head also keeps more free memory that way. DeepGEMM is off and the MoE uses Marlin: on GB10 the defaults give nonsense. Recommended sampling: temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95.
